question: A £200,000 repayment mortgage at 5% over 25 years, paid monthly. Roughly how much interest is paid in total?
answer: About £150,000. Monthly payments come to about £1,169 for 300 months, £350,750 in all, so £150,750 is interest: three-quarters of the sum borrowed. Simple interest on the full £200,000 would be £250,000, but each payment shrinks the balance the interest is charged on.
move: Multiply the payment by the number of payments before saying yes.
trap: Charging 5% a year on the whole £200,000 for 25 years.
reference: Kellison, The Theory of Interest, 3rd edition, McGraw-Hill, 2009
